🎡 FortuneWheel

A colorful spinning wheel with different prize segments — spin and see where it stops. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click the Spin button or swipe to give the wheel a push.
  2. Watch the wheel spin and gradually slow to a stop.
  3. The segment the wheel stops on determines your prize.
  4. Some wheels have bonus rounds with multiplied prizes.
  5. How hard you spin and timing can slightly affect the outcome.
